rv.q: It's one of the single most dramatic moments in the production, which says an incriminating lot about the flatness of both Gordon's script and Michael Parva's direction.

cn.t: Despite its inspiring true story of Holocaust heroism, critics find "Irena's Vow" dramatically flawed and manipulative, transforming a noble tale into theatrical hokum that exploits rather than honors its emotional subject matter.

vs.sum: The Walter Kerr Theatre offers excellent sightlines and sound quality, making it a great venue for intimate productions. However, the comfort level is below average due to limited legroom and seat width, though the theater's Italian Renaissance-inspired decor adds to its charm.

acc.note: No elevators. All accessible seating on Orchestra level. Infrared headsets and audio induction neck loops.
